INSERT IGNORE INTO tool_call_log (tenant_id, user_id, session_id, run_id, workflow_id, tool_type, tool_id, tool_name, version, invocation_id, function_call_id, idempotency_key, trace_id, input_json, output_json, status, started_at, error_type, error_message, cost_ms, metadata) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{runId}, #{workflowId}, #{toolType}, #{toolId}, #{toolName}, #{version}, #{invocationId}, #{functionCallId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{traceId}, #{inputJson}, #{outputJson}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{errorType}, #{errorMessage}, #{costMs}, #{metadata})
mapper.update: UPDATE tool_call_log SET output_json = #{outputJson}, status = #{status}, error_type = #{errorType}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, cost_ms = #{costMs} WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND status = 'started' AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tool_call_log WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM tool_call_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT MIN(t.id) AS id, t.tenant_id, t.user_id, t.session_id, MIN(t.run_id) AS run_id, MIN(t.workflow_id) AS workflow_id, t.tool_type, t.tool_id, MAX(t.tool_name) AS tool_name, t.version, NULL AS invocation_id, NULL AS function_call_id, NULL AS idempotency_key, NULL AS trace_id, NULL AS input_json, NULL AS output_json, 'success' AS status, MIN(t.started_at) AS started_at, NULL AS error_type, NULL AS error_message, NULL AS cost_ms, NULL AS metadata, MIN(t.create_time) AS create_time, MAX(t.update_time) AS update_time, 0 AS deleted FROM tool_call_log t INNER JOIN chat_message m ON m.tenant_id <=> t.tenant_id AND m.user_id = t.user_id AND m.session_id = t.session_id AND m.run_id = t.run_id AND m.validity_status = 'active' AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.session_id = #{sessionId} AND t.status = 'success' AND t.tool_id IS NOT NULL AND t.tool_id != '' AND t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.tenant_id, t.user_id, t.session_id, t.tool_type, t.tool_id, t.version ORDER BY MIN(t.id) ASC
